title: `#[derive(TypeUuid)]` does not work with primitives in generics

labels.name: D-Trivial
labels.description: Nice and easy! A great choice to get started with Bevy

body:
## Bevy version

main

## What you did

```rust
use std::marker::PhantomData;

use bevy::{prelude::*, reflect::TypeUuid};

#[derive(TypeUuid)]
#[uuid = "71402ca5-adec-436a-ba16-6980791e7c7d"]
struct Foo<T>(PhantomData<T>);

fn main() {
    App::new()
        .add_asset::<Foo<f32>>();
}
```

## What went wrong

Expected: no error.
Actual result:

```
error[E0277]: the trait bound `f32: TypeUuid` is not satisfied
   --> src\main.rs:11:10
    |
11  |         .add_asset::<Foo<f32>>();
    |          ^^^^^^^^^ the trait `TypeUuid` is not implemented for `f32`
    |
    = help: the following other types implement trait `TypeUuid`:
              AnimationClip
              AudioSink
              AudioSource
              ColorMaterial
              DynamicScene
              Font
              FontAtlasSet
              Foo<T>
            and 11 others
note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `TypeUuid` for `Foo<f32>`
   --> src\main.rs:5:10
    |
5   | #[derive(TypeUuid)]
    |          ^^^^^^^^
6   | #[uuid = "71402ca5-adec-436a-ba16-6980791e7c7d"]
7   | struct Foo<T>(PhantomData<T>);
    |        ^^^^^^
    = note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `Asset` for `Foo<f32>`
note: required by a bound in `add_asset`
   --> C:\path\to\bevy-f7ffde730c324c74\619c30c\crates\bevy_asset\src\assets.rs:280:12
    |
280 |         T: Asset;
    |            ^^^^^ required by this bound in `add_asset`
    = note: this error originates in the derive macro `TypeUuid` (in Nightly builds, run with -Z macro-backtrace for more info)
```
